decisions.reason: The existing power-to-main signal interface already carries PWRON on pin 4; adding a main-board tap does not change the interboard connector or pinout.
The panel power button uses the PWRON line and does not change the separate BOOT button or EN-to-GND reset circuit.
Relocating the power-button connector does not alter standalone USB regulation, source selection, or powered loads.
The source changes only the panel power-button connection; rail monitoring hardware, placement, and coverage remain unchanged.
Tapping the existing AXP2101 PWRON signal does not change the AXP2101 battery, USB, VMID, VSYS, or DCDC1 power path.
The decision concerns a separate power-button connector and does not change battery-connector placement, orientation, clearance, or spacing.
Although the power-button connector is no longer to be added to the power board, none of this candidate's recorded board-size, mounting, USB-C, or enclosure-fit constraints necessarily changes.
Adding a connector that taps an existing PWRON line does not change the selected ESP32-S3 module requirement.
The panel power-button connection does not affect USB-C enumeration or programming behavior.
The connector taps the existing dedicated PWRON line and does not establish or modify an ESP32-S3 GPIO assignment.
The PWRON connector change is unrelated to I2C pull-ups, series resistors, cable length, or bus speed.
The source addresses only relocation of the panel power-button connector and does not revise the separate DCDC1 3.4V regulation requirement.
